zh.text: 食刻 FoodLens 隐私政策
生效日期：待确认
食刻由 待确认 运营。本政策适用于食刻移动应用和标签识别服务。隐私相关问题可联系 [待确认](mailto:待确认)。当前版本无需注册，没有付费订阅。
照片和云端识别
你选择拍照或相册图片后，可先裁剪。应用将裁剪后的照片压缩，通过 HTTPS 发送至部署在 Cloudflare Workers 的识别接口，由 Cloudflare Workers AI 读取配料和营养表。模型由 Cloudflare 托管，照片不会另行发送至 Google AI API。
首次上传前会单独说明照片处理并征求同意。你可拒绝发送，继续体验示例。相机或相册权限不等于同意云端识别。请裁掉人脸、收据、地址等个人信息，仅上传你有权使用的图片。

我们的应用服务器不将照片、提取文字或识别结果保存到数据库或应用日志，仅为响应请求而处理并返回设备。Cloudflare 会为运行和保护基础设施处理网络及运行信息。详见 [Cloudflare 隐私政策](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/) 和 [Workers AI 数据使用说明](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/data-usage/)。
我们不将照片或结果用于广告或模型训练。Cloudflare 声明，未经明确同意不会使用 Workers AI 客户内容训练模型或改进服务。本应用未启用云端识别内容存储。
保存在设备上的信息
营养关注项、饮食关注和过敏偏好仅在设备上保存，用于排列结果和生成提醒，不随识别请求上传。
设备还保存识别记录、标签文字和营养结果、压缩缩略图、收藏、引导完成状态、云端授权状态，以及协议阅读确认的版本和时间。最多保留 50 条记录及 50 个识别食品与缩略图，新记录会替换较旧记录。当前没有食刻云端历史备份或同步。
食刻没有单独加密照片历史和偏好存储；原生使用身份凭证使用系统安全存储。设备安全、操作系统备份和照片临时文件由设备及系统管理。可使用解锁设备或共享设备的人可能看到你的记录和设置。
服务安全和次数限制
网络请求包含来源 IP 地址等传输所需信息。识别接口从 IP 生成每日密钥摘要，保存摘要、随机会话标识、UTC 请求日期和调用计数，用于防滥用和限额。摘要属于假名化信息，并非完全匿名；我们的应用数据库不保存原始 IP。
会话令牌一小时后过期。每日计数在后续 UTC 日期首次预约识别时被替换；服务闲置时，旧计数可能保留至下一次请求。Cloudflare 可能根据自身条款保留运行和安全信息，因此不能保证所有基础设施数据在识别结束后立即删除。
食刻不请求定位、通讯录或麦克风权限，未接入广告或分析 SDK，不使用广告标识符，不出售个人信息，也不为跨场景行为广告分享信息。应用未接入 Apple HealthKit 或 Android Health Connect。
体验身份与识别额度
打开会员页或使用新版真实识别时，服务器生成一个随机使用身份，并向应用返回校验凭证。原生应用使用系统安全存储保存凭证，网页版本保存在浏览器本地存储。清除照片历史和饮食设置不会清除身份或重置额度；卸载、设备迁移或浏览器清理可能丢失身份。当前不要求注册，也没有跨平台账号同步。
服务器按身份保存累计免费成功识别次数，并为正在处理的请求保留最长十分钟的预约。免费体验累计三次，不按月重置。预约结束后仅成功识别计次，失败或重拍会释放预约；超时未结束的预约会失效。服务端完成但手机未收到结果的请求可能计次。这些记录不包含标签照片、OCR 正文或饮食偏好，也不随清除本地记录自动删除。当前累计计数不会自动按日清除，会为额度核验和防滥用持续保留；可通过隐私邮箱提出适用权利请求。

正式订阅功能启用后，应用将同一使用身份交给 RevenueCat，商店及 RevenueCat 处理购买凭证、交易标识、会员权益、续订、到期及退款状态和其 SDK 实际发送的运行信息。Cloudflare 后台查询会员状态，并按商店交易生成密钥摘要，保存订阅周期时间及成功识别次数，避免恢复购买重复获得额度。不会把标签照片、营养结果、饮食关注或过敏偏好作为 RevenueCat 用户属性发送。当前购买开关关闭，未初始化 RevenueCat 购买服务；启用前须定稿政策、核实 SDK 数据披露与保留设置。
联系客服时的信息
你主动发邮件时，我们会收到邮箱地址及你提供的内容，用于回复、排查问题和履行适用法律义务。无需提交照片、诊断或详细健康资料。邮件由所使用的邮箱服务处理；请勿发送密码、支付卡信息或身份证件。
客服邮件仅保留至解决请求、处理相关争议或满足法定保留要求所需的期限。你可以请求删除，但受适用保留义务限制。
服务提供方和披露
Cloudflare 提供托管、网络安全、模型推理和调用计数存储。我们也可能为履行适用法律、响应有效法律请求或保护用户及服务而披露信息。如果服务转移至其他运营主体，涉及的信息仍须受适用隐私保护，并就实质变更通知用户。
识别接口不向服务提供方发送本地饮食设置或历史记录。打开外部参考网站或邮箱应用时，适用相应服务的隐私规则。
你的选择和删除
你可以拒绝相机权限并使用相册，拒绝照片访问并使用示例，或拒绝云端识别。权限可随时在系统设置中修改。
在「我的 → 协议与隐私 → 关闭云端识别授权」可撤回后续上传授权，已有记录仍保留。下次上传会再次询问。撤回不会撤销已完成的请求，也不会自动取消已经发送的在途请求。
在「我的 → 清除本地数据」并确认，可删除应用保存的历史、识别结果、缩略图、收藏和饮食偏好，同时重置云端授权及协议阅读确认；引导完成状态保留。清除不会删除服务端使用计数，也不保证删除系统缓存、原始相册照片或设备备份。
当前没有食刻账号需要注销。我们不能读取或远程恢复只在设备上的记录。请求访问或删除我们持有的信息，请联系 [待确认](mailto:待确认)。可能需最少量信息来验证并定位请求，不需要密码或证件号码。由于没有实名账号数据库，部分计数可能无法与你关联。
根据适用法律，你可能享有访问、更正、删除、获取副本、限制或反对处理、撤回同意及向隐私监管机构投诉的权利。我们按法律要求的期限处理请求，不因行使适用权利而歧视你。撤回同意不影响之前合法处理。
国际处理
Cloudflare 使用分布式网络，上传信息可能在所在国家以外处理；我们不承诺识别在特定国家执行。法律要求国际传输保障时，相关提供方关系和处理应适用这些保障。可联系我们了解与你的请求有关的保障措施。
儿童
食刻不面向 13 岁以下儿童，也不会有意收集其个人信息。若你认为儿童提交了个人信息，请联系我们调查和处理。当地的最低年龄及监护人同意要求也可能适用。
安全和政策更新
我们使用 HTTPS、短期签名会话令牌、服务端校验和次数限制。任何系统都无法保证绝对安全，请使用屏幕锁并在上传前检查照片。
信息处理方式变化时会更新政策和生效日期。新增账号、订阅、分析或云端历史等实质变化，将在新处理开始前说明，并在适用法律要求时另行征求同意。当前未开放支付，也未初始化 RevenueCat 购买服务；计划中的订阅数据处理见上述说明。
联系方式
运营主体：待确认
隐私邮箱：[待确认](mailto:待确认)
客服邮箱：[待确认](mailto:待确认)

en.text: FoodLens Privacy Policy
Effective date: Pending confirmation
FoodLens is operated by Pending confirmation ("we", "us", or "our"). Contact us about privacy or your information at [Pending confirmation](mailto:Pending confirmation).

FoodLens helps you read food packaging, ingredients, and nutrition labels. This policy covers the FoodLens mobile app and its recognition service. The current version does not require an account and does not offer paid subscriptions.
Photos and cloud recognition

When you choose to scan a label, the app lets you crop your selected photo and compresses it before uploading. The cropped, compressed image is sent over HTTPS to our recognition service on Cloudflare Workers and processed by Cloudflare Workers AI to extract label text and nutrition information. Cloudflare hosts the vision model; we do not send your photos to a separate Google AI API.

Before the first upload, the app explains this processing and asks you to agree. You can decline and use the example results. Camera or photo-library permission alone is not your agreement to cloud recognition. Please crop out faces, receipts, addresses, and other personal information, and only upload images you are entitled to use.

Our application server does not store photos, extracted text, or recognition results in a database or write them to application logs. They are processed to answer your request and returned to your device. Cloudflare also processes network and operational information to provide and protect its services. Its infrastructure practices are described in its [Privacy Policy](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/) and [Workers AI data usage documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/data-usage/).

We do not use your photos or results for advertising or model training. Cloudflare states that it does not use Workers AI customer content to train models or improve its services without explicit consent. We have not enabled storage of recognition content in a Cloudflare storage product.
Information saved on your device

The app saves your selected nutrition interests, dietary concerns, and allergy preferences on your device. These settings are used locally to organize results and display reminders and are not included in recognition requests.

Recognition history, extracted label text, nutrition results, compressed label thumbnails, favorites, the onboarding status, your cloud-consent setting, and the version and time of your legal-document acknowledgment are also saved locally. The app retains up to 50 history entries and up to 50 recognized foods with their thumbnails; older entries are replaced as new entries are added. There is no FoodLens cloud backup or synchronization of this history.

Photo history and preference storage are not separately encrypted by FoodLens. Native usage-identity credentials use operating-system secure storage. Device security, operating-system backups, and temporary photo files are controlled by your device and operating system. Other people with access to an unlocked or shared device may be able to view your saved information.
Service security and usage limits

Requests to our service include a source IP address and standard network information needed to deliver them. Our service uses the IP address to derive a daily keyed summary for rate limiting. It stores the summary, a random session ID, a UTC request date, and request counts to prevent abuse and enforce service limits. A keyed summary is pseudonymous information, not a guarantee of anonymity. Our application database does not store the raw IP address.

Session tokens expire after one hour. The usage-counter record for the current request day is replaced on the first recognition reservation on a later UTC day. If the service is idle, the previous counter record can remain until another request replaces it. Cloudflare may process or retain infrastructure and security information under its own applicable terms. We do not claim that all infrastructure information is deleted when a recognition response is delivered.

The app does not request location, contacts, or microphone access. It has no advertising or analytics SDK and does not use advertising identifiers, sell personal information, or share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. FoodLens does not connect to Apple HealthKit or Android Health Connect.
Usage identity and recognition allowance

When you open the membership screen or use the new recognition flow, the server issues a random usage identity and its verification credential. The native app saves the credential in operating-system secure storage; the web app saves it in local browser storage. Clearing photo history or dietary preferences does not clear this identity or reset allowance. Uninstalling, changing devices or clearing browser storage can lose it. No registration or cross-platform account synchronization is required in this version.

The server records cumulative successful free recognitions per identity and keeps an in-flight reservation for at most ten minutes. Free use allows three successful recognitions in total, without monthly resets. Success consumes allowance; failures and retake requests release reservations. An abandoned reservation expires. A request that completes on the server can count even if your phone does not receive its result. These records contain no label photos, OCR text or dietary preferences and are not deleted by clearing local history. Cumulative usage records currently have no daily automatic deletion and are retained for allowance verification and abuse prevention. Contact the privacy address to exercise applicable rights.

When real subscriptions are enabled, the app will identify the same usage identity to RevenueCat. Stores and RevenueCat process purchase receipts, transaction identifiers, entitlements, renewal, expiry and refund status and information actually sent by their SDK. The Cloudflare backend checks entitlement and uses a keyed store-transaction summary to track billing-period dates and recognition counts, preventing restoration from granting the same allowance again. Label photos, nutrition results, dietary concerns and allergies are not sent as RevenueCat customer attributes. Purchases are currently disabled and the RevenueCat purchase service is not initialized. Before activation, the policy, SDK disclosures and provider retention settings must be finalized.
Support messages

If you email us, we receive your email address and the information you choose to include. We use it to answer your request, investigate problems, and meet applicable legal obligations. You do not need to include a photo, a diagnosis, or detailed health information to contact support. Email is processed by the mailbox service we use; do not send passwords, payment-card details, or identity documents.

We keep support correspondence only as long as needed to resolve the request, handle a related dispute, or meet a legal retention requirement. You may ask us to delete it, subject to those requirements.
Service providers and disclosures

Cloudflare provides hosting, network security, cloud inference, and usage-counter storage. It processes information to operate these services. We may also disclose information when required by applicable law, to respond to a valid legal request, or to protect users and the service. If the service is transferred to another operator, the information involved remains subject to applicable privacy protections and users will be notified of material changes.

We do not provide your locally stored dietary settings or history to a service provider through the recognition API. Opening an external reference website or your email app is subject to that service's privacy practices.
Your choices and deletion

You can deny camera permission and use the photo picker, deny image access and use the examples, or decline the cloud-recognition prompt. You can change permissions in your device settings at any time.

You can withdraw permission for future uploads in My (我的) → Agreements and privacy (协议与隐私) → Turn off cloud recognition (关闭云端识别授权). Existing records remain, and the next upload will ask again. This does not retract completed or already-sent requests.

In the app, open My (我的), select Clear local data (清除本地数据), and confirm. This removes saved history, recognized foods, thumbnails, favorites, and dietary preferences from the app's saved state, and resets cloud consent and the legal-document acknowledgment. It keeps the onboarding-completed flag. The app will ask for agreement again before another cloud upload. Stop submitting photos if you want to stop cloud processing. Clearing local data does not retract a completed request, delete usage counters on our server, or necessarily delete operating-system photo caches or backups.

There is currently no FoodLens account to delete. We cannot read or remotely recover history stored only on your device. To request access to or deletion of information we hold, contact [Pending confirmation](mailto:Pending confirmation). We may ask for the minimum information needed to verify and locate your request; we do not need your account password or identity-document number. Because we do not maintain a named account database, we may not be able to associate a request with a particular usage counter without additional information.

Depending on the laws that apply to you, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or receive your personal information, restrict or object to certain processing, withdraw consent, or complain to the relevant privacy authority. We handle requests within the deadlines required by applicable law and do not discriminate against you for exercising applicable privacy rights. Withdrawing consent does not affect processing that already occurred lawfully.
International processing

Cloudflare operates a distributed network, and information sent to the recognition service may be processed outside your country. We do not promise that recognition runs in a particular country. Where applicable law requires safeguards for international transfers, those safeguards must apply to the relevant provider relationship and processing. Contact us for information about safeguards applicable to your request.
Children

FoodLens is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has submitted personal information, contact us so we can investigate and address information we hold. Local minimum-age and parental-consent requirements may also apply.
Security and changes

We use HTTPS for recognition requests, signed short-lived session tokens, server-side validation, and usage limits. No system can guarantee absolute security; use your device's screen lock and review images before sending them.

We will update this policy when our practices change and update the effective date. Material changes, such as adding accounts, subscriptions, analytics, or cloud history, will be explained before the new processing begins, with consent where required. The current version does not enable payments or initialize RevenueCat purchases. Planned subscription information handling is described above.
Contact
Operator: Pending confirmation
Privacy: [Pending confirmation](mailto:Pending confirmation)
Support: [Pending confirmation](mailto:Pending confirmation)

zh.text: 食刻 FoodLens 用户协议
生效日期：待确认
食刻由 待确认 提供。关于应用或本协议的问题，请联系 [待确认](mailto:待确认)。在适用法律允许的范围内，使用食刻表示同意本协议；不同意请停止使用。你的法定消费者权利不受影响。
服务内容
食刻读取食品包装照片中的配料和营养信息，提供一般性标签解读和饮食提醒。无需上传照片也可体验标明为示例的虚构食品及数据。
云端识别需联网，并需单独同意将裁剪图片发送至 Cloudflare Workers AI。当前没有食刻账号、云端记录同步或付费订阅。信息处理详见 [隐私政策](privacy.html)。
营养信息和医疗限制
食刻不是医疗器械，不诊断、治疗、治愈或预防疾病。医疗建议、诊断或治疗应咨询合格医疗专业人员。应用不能判断某种食品是否适合你的具体疾病、孕期、用药或饮食限制。
识别可能漏读或误读配料、过敏原、单位、份量和营养值，尤其是小字、反光或不完整照片。缺失值不等于零。使用结果前请核对原包装、份量及厂商信息。当前未宣称准确率或临床验证。
没有过敏提醒不代表安全。应用过敏原列表和提醒并不完整；严重过敏或医学饮食限制者不能仅凭应用决定食用。食刻不能检验食品、检测污染或验证厂商声明。
每日参考值比较采用页面注明的标准，例如美国 FDA 成人每日参考值，并非个人饮食目标。不同标签体系可能采用不同参考量。份量换算依赖标签数据和你选择的用量。
使用和上传图片
仅上传你有权使用的照片，裁掉他人面部和个人信息。你保留上传内容的权利，并允许我们及服务提供方按隐私政策，仅为提供和保护你请求的识别服务处理内容。
不得滥用服务、绕过限额、破坏安全、上传违法内容或通过自动请求耗尽共享额度。你须符合当地适用的年龄和同意要求。食刻不面向 13 岁以下儿童。
可用性与本地记录
识别受限额、模型和网络状态影响。体验版共享每日识别预算，并非保证每位用户每天都有固定次数。即使应用正常打开，识别也可能暂时不可用或出错。
记录和偏好在设备保存。清除数据、更换设备或卸载可能导致记录无法使用，当前没有云端恢复服务。操作系统备份及临时图片由设备管理。
我们可按适用法律更新功能、限额或限制滥用。如果将来推出付费方案，购买前会显示权益、限额、价格、期限、续订和取消条件。本协议不授权未披露的收费。
付费说明
本版本免费，没有支付流程。接受协议或允许云端识别不会开启订阅。未来商店购买需另外确认，并适用相应订阅条款。删除应用或清除数据不会取消未来版本中已购买的订阅。
知识产权和外部链接
食刻品牌及应用内容归相应权利人所有。本协议不转移应用或你提交照片的所有权，开源组件仍适用各自许可。外部参考网站有其自己的条款和隐私政策；提供链接不代表背书或保证内容一直有效。
责任与消费者权利
我们按适用法律，以合理注意提供服务。应用不能替代检查食品包装或获得专业建议。在法律允许范围内，不保证识别始终准确或服务不中断。
本协议不排除依法不能排除的责任或救济，包括强制消费者保护；未设置强制仲裁或放弃法定隐私权的条款。对你适用的强制法律和法律救济仍可使用。
更新和联系
服务变化时可能修订协议，并标明生效日期。实质变化会在适用前通过应用或服务告知，并在法律要求时征求同意。
运营主体：待确认
客服邮箱：[待确认](mailto:待确认)
隐私邮箱：[待确认](mailto:待确认)
从 App Store 获取应用时，除非通过 App Store Connect 提供有效的自定义许可，还适用 Apple 的 [标准应用许可协议](https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/)。本服务协议不取代商店购买规则。

en.text: FoodLens Terms of Use
Effective date: Pending confirmation

FoodLens is provided by Pending confirmation. Contact [Pending confirmation](mailto:Pending confirmation) for questions about the app or these terms. By using FoodLens, you agree to these terms to the extent permitted by applicable law. If you do not agree, stop using the service. Your statutory consumer rights remain unaffected.
The service

FoodLens extracts information from photos of food labels, presents ingredients and nutrition values, and offers general educational reminders. You can use example results without uploading a photo. Example products and their data are fictional and are identified as examples.

Cloud recognition requires an internet connection and your agreement to send the cropped image to Cloudflare Workers AI. The app currently has no FoodLens account, no cloud history synchronization, and no paid subscription. Our [Privacy Policy](privacy.html) explains information handling.
Nutrition information and medical limitations

FoodLens is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. Consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. It does not determine whether a food is safe for your particular disease, pregnancy, medication, or dietary restriction.

Image recognition can miss or misread ingredients, allergen statements, units, serving sizes, and nutrition values, especially with small print, glare, or incomplete photos. Missing values are not zero. Check the original packaging, serving size, and manufacturer information before relying on any result. No accuracy rate or clinical validation is claimed.

An absence of an allergy warning does not mean a product is safe. The app's allergy list and reminders are incomplete. Do not rely on the app to decide whether to eat a food when you have a severe allergy or a medically required restriction. It cannot test food, detect contamination, or verify a manufacturer's statements.

Any displayed daily-value comparison uses the stated reference, such as U.S. FDA adult Daily Values, and is not an individualized dietary target. Values from different labeling systems may use different reference amounts. Portion calculations depend on the label and the amount you select.
Your use and images

Only upload images you have the right to use. Crop out other people's faces and personal information. You retain your rights in uploaded content and allow us and the service providers to process it only as needed to provide and protect the requested recognition service, as described in the Privacy Policy.

Do not misuse the service, bypass usage limits, interfere with its security, upload unlawful material, or use automated requests to exhaust shared capacity. You must meet the minimum age and consent requirements applicable to you. FoodLens is not directed to children under 13.
Availability and local data

Recognition is subject to service limits, model availability, and network conditions. The current preview uses a shared daily recognition budget, not a guaranteed individual daily allowance. Recognition may be temporarily unavailable or return an error even when the app opens normally.

History and preferences are stored on your device. Clearing app data, replacing the device, or removing the app can make this information unavailable. FoodLens does not currently offer a cloud recovery service. Operating-system backups and temporary images are managed by your device.

We may update features and limits, or restrict abusive use, subject to applicable law. If paid plans are introduced, their benefits, limits, prices, duration, renewal conditions, and cancellation instructions must be shown before purchase; these terms do not authorize an undisclosed charge.
Payments

This version is free to use and does not contain a payment flow. No subscription starts by accepting these terms or giving cloud-recognition permission. Any future store purchase will require a separate purchase confirmation and applicable subscription terms. Removing the app or clearing its data does not cancel a subscription purchased in a later version.
Intellectual property and external resources

FoodLens branding and app content belong to their respective rights holders. These terms do not transfer ownership of the app or your submitted images. Open-source components remain subject to their applicable licenses. Third-party reference websites have their own terms and privacy policies; a link is not an endorsement or a guarantee that their content remains current.
Responsibility and consumer rights

We provide the service with reasonable care, subject to applicable law. The app cannot replace checking food packaging or obtaining professional advice. To the extent permitted by law, we do not warrant that recognition is always accurate or that the service is uninterrupted.

Nothing in these terms excludes liability or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded, including mandatory consumer protections. There is no mandatory arbitration provision or contractual waiver of statutory privacy rights in these terms. The mandatory laws and legal remedies applicable to you remain available.
Changes and contact

We may revise these terms as the service changes and will identify the effective date. Material changes will be communicated through the app or service before they apply, with agreement where required by law.

zh.text: 食刻 FoodLens 帮助与支持
食刻帮助你读懂食品配料与营养表，由 待确认 运营。应用问题请联系 [待确认](mailto:待确认)，隐私请求请联系 [待确认](mailto:待确认)。
识别失败或结果不准确
拍清楚配料和营养表，保持稳定、避开反光，裁剪时保留份量及过敏信息。如果信息在包装不同面，可分别拍摄相关部分，并核对原包装。
应用会压缩裁剪后的照片，同时尽量保留文字清晰。像素大本身不代表上传失败。网络连接、标签模糊、模型状态或共享服务限额可能导致失败；检查网络后重试，避免短时间内重复请求。
联系客服时可提供应用版本、设备型号、系统版本和错误文字。若主动附照片，请先移除个人信息。不要发送密码、银行卡、身份证件或不必要的健康资料。结果有误或令人担忧时，可提供错误字段及原标签文字。
云端授权与删除数据
首次发送照片前需单独同意云端处理，相机权限与云端授权是两项不同选择。拒绝云端处理仍可体验示例。

当前没有账号，也无法远程恢复设备上的记录。保留、云端处理及隐私权利详见 [隐私政策](privacy.html)。

en.text: FoodLens Support

FoodLens helps you read ingredients and nutrition labels from a photo. Contact [Pending confirmation](mailto:Pending confirmation) for app support or [Pending confirmation](mailto:Pending confirmation) for privacy requests. FoodLens is operated by Pending confirmation.
Recognition problems

Use a clear photo of the ingredients and nutrition panel. Keep the camera steady, avoid glare, and crop closely without removing serving sizes or allergen statements. If different panels are on different sides of a package, scan the relevant panel separately and check the original label before using the result.

The app compresses a cropped image before upload to keep text readable and reduce transfer size. Large image dimensions alone do not show that an upload failed. Connection errors, an unclear label, model availability, or a shared service limit may prevent a result. Try again after checking your network; avoid repeated rapid retries.

For help, email your app version, device model, operating-system version, and the error message. If you choose to attach a photo, remove personal information first. Do not send passwords, payment-card details, identity documents, or unnecessary health information. You may report an incorrect or concerning result to the same support address; include the field that was wrong and the label wording if possible.
Privacy and deleting local data

Photos are sent for recognition only after the app's cloud-processing prompt is accepted. Camera permission and cloud-processing agreement are separate choices. Declining the prompt leaves example results available.

To stop future uploads, open My (我的) → Agreements and privacy (协议与隐私) → Turn off cloud recognition (关闭云端识别授权). Existing history remains and the next upload asks again. This does not retract already-sent requests.

To remove app-saved information, open My (我的), select Clear local data (清除本地数据), and confirm. This clears history, recognized text and values, thumbnails, favorites, preferences, the cloud-consent setting, and the legal-document acknowledgment. The onboarding-completed flag remains. It does not necessarily clear device-managed temporary files or backups, and it does not remove server usage counters.

FoodLens currently has no account and no remote history recovery. See the [Privacy Policy](privacy.html) for retention, cloud processing, and privacy rights. Contact the privacy address above for requests about information we hold.
Payments

Purchases are not enabled in this preview. The new free-use identity has three successful recognitions in total. My → FoodLens Pro Monthly opens allowance and plan information. Clearing local history does not reset server allowance or clear the usage credential. If a future version offers a subscription, its purchase screen will show the store price, billing period, benefits, usage limits, and renewal conditions before confirmation. Store subscription settings control cancellation; deleting the app does not cancel store billing.
Health information

FoodLens is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. Consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Verify original packaging and manufacturer allergen statements. No warning is not proof that a food is safe for you.
Read the [Terms of Use](terms.html) for service conditions.

zh.text: 健康信息与识别说明
食刻提供一般性食品标签解读，不是医疗器械，不诊断、治疗、治愈或预防疾病。医疗建议、诊断或治疗请咨询合格医疗专业人员。
请以原包装为准
模型可能误读或漏读配料、营养值、单位、份量或过敏声明。反光、模糊、小字及不完整照片会影响结果。未识别出的数值不等于零；未出现提醒也不等于食品安全。食用前核对原包装及厂商说明。
过敏和疾病提醒
应用过敏原列表并不完整，不能排除生产线交叉接触或包装未披露的风险。严重过敏者不要只凭食刻决定食用。
关于血糖、血脂、血压和其他饮食关注的提醒仅为一般教育信息，不是疾病食用许可。确诊疾病、孕期、用药或医学饮食限制应遵循医疗专业人员的个体化建议。
份量与营养参考
每份、每 100 克和整包换算依赖识别数据及你选择的用量。每日参考值比较采用结果页注明的参考标准，例如美国 FDA 成人每日参考值，不是你的个人目标。不同国家标签标准可能不同。
示例与云端结果
示例产品及数据为虚构演示。真实照片由 Cloudflare Workers AI 识别，未经临床验证，也未宣称准确率保证。当前应用不收费，不提供订阅。

en.text: Health and Recognition Notice

FoodLens provides general food-label education. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. Consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
Check the original packaging

Recognition may miss or misread ingredients, nutrition values, units, serving sizes, or allergen statements. Glare, blur, small print, and incomplete photos affect results. Missing values are not zero, and no warning does not mean a food is safe. Check the original label and manufacturer information before eating.
Allergies and medical restrictions
The app's allergen list is incomplete and cannot rule out cross-contact or undisclosed risks. Do not rely solely on FoodLens when you have a severe allergy.

Reminders about blood glucose, blood lipids, blood pressure, or other dietary concerns are general education, not permission to eat a food with a medical condition. Follow individualized professional advice for diagnosed conditions, pregnancy, medication, or medically required dietary restrictions.
Portions and reference values

Per-serving, per-100-gram, and whole-package calculations depend on recognized data and your selected amount. Daily-value comparisons use the reference identified on the results screen, such as U.S. FDA adult Daily Values, rather than an individual dietary target. National labeling systems may differ.
Examples and cloud results

Example products and data are fictional. Real label photos are read by Cloudflare Workers AI. The app does not claim clinical validation or a guaranteed accuracy rate. The current app is free and has no subscription.
See the [Terms of Use](terms.html) and [Privacy Policy](privacy.html).

en.text: FoodLens Pro Monthly Subscription Terms

This plan is being prepared. Purchases are not enabled in the current preview and it cannot charge you. Effective date: Pending confirmation. Operator: Pending confirmation. Support: [Pending confirmation](mailto:Pending confirmation).
Monthly plan

FoodLens Pro renews monthly. The proposed reference price is CNY 9.90. Overseas stores display their actual localized currency and price; the purchase screen and store confirmation identify the applicable price, currency, billing period and taxes. This plan has no annual option or free subscription trial.

Each anonymous free-use identity receives three successful recognitions in total, without a monthly reset. An active monthly subscription includes 50 successful recognitions per subscription period. A successful renewal starts a new period. Unused recognitions do not carry over or have cash value. Examples use no allowance. Failed recognitions and retake requests do not consume plan allowance.

The server records usage, so deleting local photos or history does not reset it. An already-sent request can count if it completes successfully on the server, even if your phone loses its connection, you stop waiting, or you do not receive the result. Service unavailability does not consume plan allowance. Contact support if a completed request consumed allowance without delivering a result.
Purchase and activation

Apple or Google processes payment through its in-app purchase system. FoodLens does not receive full payment-card details. Access begins after store payment confirmation and backend verification. Pending approval, failed payments and canceled purchases do not activate a subscription. Do not purchase again merely because a confirmation is delayed.
Renewal, cancellation and refunds

The store renews and charges your subscription unless you cancel by its applicable deadline. Renewal dates, price changes and any required confirmation follow the store's notices and subscription settings.

My membership → Manage subscription opens the relevant store settings. Cancellation generally stops the next renewal and retains access during the paid period, subject to store rules. Uninstalling, clearing app data or deleting a future account does not cancel store billing.

Request refunds through [Apple](https://support.apple.com/118223) or [Google Play](https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/2479637?hl=en), subject to store rules and applicable law. FoodLens support can help investigate access problems. These terms do not limit statutory consumer or refund rights.
Restoring purchases and identity

Restore on the original purchase platform with the same store account, subject to configured store and RevenueCat restoration and transfer rules. Restoration does not grant a fresh allowance for the same billing period.

The first version does not require a FoodLens registration. The server issues a random usage identity, whose credential is saved by the app and used for configured subscription verification. Anonymous Android and iOS identities do not automatically share subscriptions or synchronize photo history. A lost identity, reinstall or replacement device may require purchase restoration. Do not share your credential.
Service and information handling

Pro increases real label-recognition allowance. It does not provide medical diagnosis, allergen safety certification, clinical validation or guaranteed accuracy. Check original packaging and seek professional medical advice. Recognition depends on networks, model availability and anti-abuse limits.

When real purchases are enabled, RevenueCat helps verify store transactions, renewals, expiration, refunds and entitlements. Purchase must use an active [Privacy Policy](privacy.html) and [Terms of Use](terms.html) reflecting the configured providers and processing. Label photos and dietary preferences are not sent as RevenueCat customer attributes.

Until operator identity and public contacts are confirmed, this document is a plan draft. Store products, service capacity, identity restoration and billing must be verified before purchase is enabled.
